entities.name: Sugar Economy and Enslaved Labor
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Both Saint Kitts and Nevis were transformed into sugar monocultures. Nevis became one of the wealthiest islands per capita in the Caribbean by the late 17th century. Tens of thousands of enslaved Africans were imported to work under brutal conditions on sugar plantations across both islands.
